fixes_applied 7 = the three blocking findings (al-Faw region, Majnoon region, Haj Omran event) plus four thin items that loaded (Majnoon end date, 1987 extra cells via Karbala-5 and Karbala-10, Kurdish towns of 1979-1980, Iraq's July 1988 incursion at Dehloran and Qasr-e Shirin); the fourth finding is the cross-dossier item above and is routed, not applied.

Pages opened for Iran now exceed the 5-page budget (15 sources); the extra pages are the repair. Wikipedia title Operation_Tawakalna_ala_Allah does not exist; the article is Tawakalna_ala_Allah_Operations.
